title: V2: Preserve v1 and ship the Phaser survival foundation on GitHub Pages
body:
Preserve the original real-time enemy swarm design and existing Fire Emblem assets.

Acceptance criteria:
- Archive existing game and controller source under v1, including local edits.
- Scaffold Phaser 3, TypeScript strict mode and Vite.
- Playable character selection, movement, melee, waves, damage, pickups, pause and clean restart.
- Automated rules and browser smoke tests pass.
- Deploy a verified build to https://joncady.github.io/feadventures/ using GitHub Actions.

This is the initial migration slice. Full feature parity is tracked separately.

title: V2: Port directional movement and attack sprite animations
body:
The initial migration uses the standing-row animation frames from the original 200×492 sprite sheets.

Acceptance criteria:
- Define exact frame boundaries for all original directional and attack rows.
- Port movement, facing, idle and attack animations for Chrom, Lucina, Frederick and all enemies.
- Preserve the last facing direction when attacking from idle.
- Verify there is no frame bleeding at scaled resolutions.

title: V2: Add obstacle-aware swarm navigation
body:
The foundation uses direct pursuit with Arcade Physics terrain collisions. Enemies can become blocked behind the original map obstacles.

Acceptance criteria:
- Derive a navigation grid from map geometry.
- Route melee enemies around obstacles toward the living player.
- Bound and stagger path recalculation as swarm sizes increase.
- Verify all spawn regions can reach the player and spawning never occurs inside terrain.
- Add tests for blocked paths and unreachable targets.

title: V2: Restore enemy combat roles and ranged projectiles
body:
The initial migration renders all five original enemy types but uses contact damage for each. Restore the distinct original combat roles.

Acceptance criteria:
- Archer keeps distance and fires arrows with directional visuals.
- Melee enemies use configurable range, damage and attack cooldowns.
- Projectiles collide with terrain and players and expire cleanly.
- Enemy attacks telegraph clearly and cannot damage after death or scene shutdown.
- Verify projectile cleanup across wave transitions and repeated restarts.

title: V2: Restore local co-op and evaluate browser controller support
body:
The original game attempted two-player keyboard input and a separate GameCube adapter server. The initial migration is single-player.

Acceptance criteria:
- Support at most two selected players with separate input bindings.
- Support living-player targeting and end the game only when everyone is dead.
- Add browser Gamepad API input with connection and disconnection handling.
- Test the actual GameCube adapter in supported browsers; retain an optional local bridge only if browser support requires it.
- The hosted game must run without a localhost server for keyboard play.

title: V2: Migrate map progression and data-driven waves
body:
The foundation uses the original first map and increasing enemy counts. Expand content through typed data instead of scene-specific branching.

Acceptance criteria:
- Port remaining map assets with collision definitions and safe player spawns.
- Configure enemy mixes, wave budgets, spawn cadence and pickup frequency per stage.
- Provide an explicit stage transition and progress display.
- Test that a cleared wave advances exactly once and final map behavior is defined.

title: V2: Expand browser regression coverage and performance checks
body:
Keep the github.io game playable as migration features are added.

Acceptance criteria:
- Cover movement displacement, terrain collisions, directional melee and wave progression in browser tests.
- Cover repeated deaths/restarts, hero reselection, pause/resume and tab focus changes.
- Test asset loading under /feadventures/ as well as a site root.
- Profile large swarms and set a practical enemy cap.
- Add Firefox and WebKit coverage where supported, with CI failures blocking publication.

title: V2: Add touch controls and accessible gameplay settings
body:
The initial migration scales its canvas but requires a keyboard. Improve input and usability for the public browser build.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add touch movement and attack controls without obscuring combat.
- Add separate music/effects levels and persist preferences.
- Support remappable keyboard controls and a reduced-motion option.
- Verify menus are usable with keyboard focus and narrow screens.
- Show a clear loading failure/retry state when assets cannot be loaded.
